item.title: Self-Hosted Cloud Cost Estimation: Infracost vs OpenCost vs Cloud Custodian
item.description: Managing cloud infrastructure costs is one of the biggest challenges for engineering teams running production workloads. Without proper cost visibility, organizations routinely overspend by 30-40% on unused resources, over-provisioned instances, and inefficient architectures.
